name: Governance Attack
description: Weaknesses in governance mechanisms allowing malicious proposal execution

detectors.name: No Quorum Requirement
detectors.description: Governance proposals can pass with minimal participation

detectors.name: No Timelock on Execution
detectors.description: Proposals execute immediately after passing without delay

detectors.name: Flash Loan Governance Manipulation
detectors.description: Voting power can be flash loaned at proposal snapshot

detectors.name: Proposal Cancelation Issues
detectors.description: Proposers can cancel their own proposals after voting starts

remediation: Implement proper quorum requirements, use timelock for proposal execution, take snapshots before voting begins, require tokens to be held for a period before voting

historical.description: Flash loan governance attack, no delay on execution
Malicious proposal passed via social engineering
